title: TopologyArtifactOverlayStatusData
description: Type-specific data for a topology artifact stream frame of type 'overlay_status'. Reports runtime health of overlay layers without changing the topology patch payload model.

artifactId.description: Topology artifact whose runtime overlay layers are being evaluated.

overlayRevision.description: Artifact overlay revision this status applies to.

layers.description: Runtime status for active or requested live overlay layers.
